approach: Write docs/spec.toml as [[requirement]] and [[question]] tables with verbatim quotes and headings from BRIEF.md sections 1-6. Add xtask/tests/spec.rs with a pure check(spec_toml, brief_text) function (toml+serde, already xtask dev-dependencies), a banned-word scan copied from policy.rs M19, a heading check, a section 1-6 coverage function, and in-memory positive and negative tests. Add CHANGELOG entry, decisions.md D111 and an M33 enforcement row. Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and ontology.toml stay unchanged.

decisions.choice: TOML [[requirement]] tables parsed with toml+serde in a Rust test
decisions.reason: Repo already uses TOML; crates already present; nothing hand-parsed (buy-first).

rejected.why: No comments; painful long quotes; hard for Sri to approve.
New crate; implicit typing and indentation errors.

decisions.choice: Compare quotes and BRIEF.md after split_whitespace().join(' '); markdown characters kept in the quote.

A source heading is valid only if BRIEF.md, within the Olympus range (lines 550-865, found by locating the '## 1. Vision' line to the end of R8), has a line equal to one or more '#' + one space + the heading text. Section group comes from the heading: '1. Vision', '2.', '3.', '4.', '5.', 'R1'..'R8'; sub-headings (3.x, Stage A-F, 5.1) fold into their parent by their number prefix or by position in the range.
decisions.reason: Briefs headings carry '## ' / '### ' prefixes (e.g. line 560, 786, 678); restricting to the range stops Athena-brief headings counting toward coverage.

decisions.choice: M19 safety: no quote may contain a word banned by policy.rs boundary_words(). spec.rs copies that fragment list (citing policy.rs as source) and scans every statement and quote in the spec text; a planted banned word in an in-memory quote is flagged. For the Hermes row (BRIEF.md:597 contains 'handoffs') quote the substring 'Routes work, manages dependencies, context,' only.
decisions.reason: M19 scans git-tracked files only, so an untracked spec.toml would pass policy during the run and fail after commit; the own scan makes the check independent of git tracking.

rejected.option: Rely on cargo test -p xtask --test policy
rejected.why: Does not see an untracked file.

decisions.choice: Coverage limited to sections 1-6 via one const array of groups that job two extends.
Pure check function; negative tests mutate one small valid in-memory spec.
decisions.reason: Shows each failure mode without files.

decisions.choice: [[question]] with id, text, sources (>=2 quotes), validated like requirement quotes; empty list allowed.
decisions.reason: Criterion 5 needs the format supported; no invented conflict.

decisions.choice: xtask/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and docs/ontology.toml are unchanged.
decisions.reason: xtask/Cargo.toml lines 20-24 already list regex, serde and toml as dev-dependencies, so the lock is unchanged; ontology only adds terms that caused a misread, none expected.

files.purpose: Spec for Olympus sections 1-6: requirements and questions with verbatim quotes and headings; header comment on format and scope.
check function, banned-word scan, heading check, coverage, real-file test and negative/schema tests.
Entry for the spec and its checking test.
D111: spec format, TOML vs alternatives, buy-first, job-two note.
M33 row naming the spec tests so M24 stays true.

steps: Read BRIEF.md 550-865 in full; read policy.rs lines 53-103 (athena_files, boundary_words), M24 defined_tests/named_tests (~466-474), and the enforcement.md row format.

Write xtask/tests/spec.rs: serde structs with deny_unknown_fields; normalize; check (schema, unique ids, supersedes, sources, quote substring, heading match to '#'+ space + heading within the Olympus range, banned-word scan); group/coverage function with a const group array.

Write the baseline and negative tests (bad quote, duplicate id, missing supersedes, no source, bad kind/status, planted banned word, missing coverage group, question parse and bad question quote); run and see them fail on an empty spec.
Author docs/spec.toml with header comment; quote Hermes row as a substring without the banned word; add questions or a comment saying none.
Run cargo test -p xtask --test spec and fix quotes and coverage.
Add M33 row to enforcement.md, D111 to decisions.md, and the CHANGELOG entry. Leave Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and ontology.toml untouched.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, clippy and cargo test --locked; note M19/M24 are confirmed fully on the committed tree.

risks.risk: Quotes with smart punctuation, tables or em dashes fail to match.
risks.mitigation: Copy from the file; run the test after each batch.

risks.risk: Untracked spec.rs means M24 cannot find the M33 tests, and M19 cannot see spec.toml, until Athena commits.
risks.mitigation: spec.rs does its own banned-word scan; the M33 row stays; the final run is on the committed tree; the producer never runs git add.
One requirement per idea, merge duplicates, short statements; about 40-60 requirements (estimate).

risks.risk: Spec asserts who runs Athena or where.
risks.mitigation: State Olympus behavior only; own scan plus policy test.

risks.risk: Clippy workspace lints reject test patterns.
risks.mitigation: Mirror policy.rs style; run clippy on all targets.

demonstrations.method: Real-file test runs check on docs/spec.toml and BRIEF.md.
demonstrations.observes: the_spec_is_valid_against_the_brief passes: quotes are whitespace-collapsed substrings, ids unique, supersedes targets exist, each requirement has a source.
demonstrations.fails_without: A bad quote, duplicate id, dangling supersedes, unsourced requirement or missing file fails it.

demonstrations.method: Four in-memory mutation tests of a valid baseline spec, each asserting a specific error from check; a baseline test shows the unmutated spec passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: If check skipped any of the four checks, the matching test would see Ok and fail.

demonstrations.method: sections_one_to_six_are_covered groups requirements by source headings (validated against BRIEF.md Olympus range) and requires at least one for each of 13 groups: sections 1-5 and R1-R8; a negative test with a missing group asserts it is reported by name.
demonstrations.observes: Test passes; on failure lists uncovered groups.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing group such as R6 fails and is named.

demonstrations.method: Schema check enforces kind in goal/requirement/constraint/acceptance, status in active/superseded, non-empty statement, and quote+heading per source; reviewer reads docs/spec.toml for coverage of the Vision list, Pantheon table, feedback sub-sections, Stages A-F, 5.1 and R1-R8 with duplicates merged.
demonstrations.observes: Passes with schema enforced; file read shows merged multi-source requirements.
demonstrations.fails_without: An invalid kind, status or empty statement fails the schema test.

demonstrations.method: If sections 1-6 contain a conflict or open choice, spec.toml has a [[question]] with both verbatim quotes; otherwise a header comment says none was found. In-memory tests show a question with two quotes parses and one with a bad quote is flagged.
demonstrations.observes: Question tests pass; question quotes validated like requirement quotes.
demonstrations.fails_without: A question quote absent from BRIEF.md fails check.

demonstrations.method: Two checks: spec.rs scans docs/spec.toml text for the copied M19 word list (independent of git tracking), with an in-memory test that a planted banned word is flagged; and the policy test runs. Reader confirms no statement on who runs Athena or where. Note policy.rs only sees the file once tracked, so the final Athena run on the committed tree confirms it.
demonstrations.observes: The banned-word scan test and a_banned_word_in_a_quote_is_flagged pass; then cargo test -p xtask --test policy also passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: A quote like the full Hermes row with 'handoffs' would fail the spec.rs scan even uncommitted.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks. M24 reads only tracked .rs files, so the M33 row's test names are found only once xtask/tests/spec.rs is tracked; Athena tracks it, the producer does not run git add. The producer keeps the M33 row and does not drop it to make an untracked run pass; the final criterion 7 run is on the committed tree.
demonstrations.observes: Clippy clean; cargo fmt --check and cargo test --locked also pass on the committed tree, including M24.
demonstrations.fails_without: A lint, format difference or misnamed test in the enforcement map fails.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff of CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md.
demonstrations.observes: CHANGELOG.md has a spec entry; docs/decisions.md has D111 with format, TOML choice, rejected Markdown with ids, JSON and YAML, and note that sections 7-10, governing philosophy and 2026-10-17 addenda follow in a second job.

open_questions: Whether sections 1-6 contain a conflict or open choice in Sri's words; I did not read sections 3-6 in full. The producer reads BRIEF.md 550-865 and decides.
Exact banned-word list in policy.rs boundary_words() (lines 88-103); the producer copies it and may find more words than 'handoffs' in sections 1-6, to be left out of quotes by substring choice.
Exact line range of Olympus sections 1-6 (about 550-865); the producer finds it from the headings.
